seoDescription: For grades 1–12, Rutherford County Schools starts 2026–27 with a two-hour orientation Aug. 7 and first full day Aug. 10. Find breaks, official PDFs, and ICS.
heroSummary: Rutherford County Schools starts the 2026–27 school year with a two-hour orientation on Friday, August 7, followed by the first full day on Monday, August 10. Those opening dates apply to students in grades 1–12; kindergarten follows a separate phase-in schedule. December 18 and the last day of school, May 28, are also two-hour student days. Winter Break ends January 1, but January 4 is an in-service and safety day, so students return January 5. Major breaks and the full district calendar are listed below.

customSections.label: RCS Opens with a Two-Hour Orientation Day
customSections.content: RCS has four staff-only days August 3–6. Students in grades 1–12 first report on Friday, August 7, for a two-hour orientation, followed by their first full day on Monday, August 10. Kindergarten follows a separate phase-in schedule, with official 2026–27 calendars available in English, Spanish, and Arabic.

table.footnote: Revision note: An earlier RCS school post published before June 3 lists August 3 as Admin/Safety Day and August 4 as In-Service Day. The revised district calendar lists August 3 as In-Service Day and August 4 as Admin/Safety Day. Both are no-school days for students.

customSections.label: Two-Hour Student Days and the Last Week of School
customSections.content: RCS lists three two-hour student dates in 2026–27. August 7 is the grades 1–12 orientation day; December 18 and May 28 are also two-hour days. May 27 is different: it is a teacher workday when students do not attend, followed by the two-hour last day on May 28.

calendarFaqs.q: Is August 7 the first day of school for Rutherford County Schools?
calendarFaqs.a: For students in grades 1–12, August 7 is a two-hour orientation day and the first full day is Monday, August 10, 2026. Kindergarten follows a separate phase-in schedule published by RCS.

calendarFaqs.q: When do RCS students return after Winter Break?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs through January 1. January 4 is an in-service and safety day with no school for students, so classes resume Tuesday, January 5, 2027.
No. December 18 is a two-hour day for students and teachers, and it is the end of the second nine weeks.

calendarFaqs.q: Are RCS parent/teacher conference dates no-school days?
calendarFaqs.a: The district calendar lists conferences on October 20 and March 18 but does not label those dates as no-school days. Confirm the conference schedule and any dismissal changes with the student's school.

calendarFaqs.q: Is the last day of school a full day?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Friday, May 28, 2027, is a two-hour student day, and report cards are issued. Students do not attend on the teacher workday May 27.

calendarFaqs.q: Do the Spanish and Arabic RCS calendars use different dates?
calendarFaqs.a: No. They are official language editions of the same revised 2026–27 academic calendar, not separate attendance schedules.

sourceReviewSummary: Reviewed August 22, 2026 against the complete Rutherford County Schools calendar revised June 3, 2026 and its official Spanish and Arabic editions.
sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we reviewed the RCS calendar
sourceReviewDetails: Reviewed every date on the one-page English calendar, including the opening sequence, student no-school dates, two-hour days, breaks, conferences, reporting dates, and the last student day.
Checked the Spanish and Arabic calendars against the English edition; all three show the same district schedule and June 3 revision date.
Confirmed that August 7 is a two-hour orientation day, August 10 is the first full student day, January 4 is a staff day before students return January 5, and May 28 is a two-hour last day.
Confirmed that the August 7 orientation and August 10 first full day apply to grades 1–12 and that RCS publishes separate kindergarten phase-in calendars in English, Spanish, and Arabic.
The English source URL ends in .docx, but RCS currently serves the file as a one-page PDF. That is the official file reviewed for this page.
Compared the June 3 revision with an earlier RCS school post that reversed the August 3–4 staff-day labels; both dates remain no-school days for students.
sourceNextReviewText: We review this page again when RCS publishes a revised calendar or announces a districtwide schedule change.
